messages:
Lia: Heads up — I need to swap primary for the 18:00–23:00 window. flight got delayed, ETA > 22:30. can someone pick up primary? I can shadow until 20:00 then hand off to whoever takes primary.

Maria: I can take primary from 19:30–23:30 if that helps. I have pager open until then. @Devon @Sam any objections?

oncall-bot: Reminder: primary/secondary swap requires overlap >= 15m and runbook pointer posted. Use /handoff when ready.

Devon: I can cover 20:00–02:00 if Maria wants to sign out earlier. but depends on Sam. also have a quick deploy at 21:15 that I'll be around for.

Sam: I can be secondary for that window. Maria -> Devon handoff works for me. Lia — can you post the runbook link + any active alerts?

Lia: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/primsec-rotation — section 'quick swap' has checklist. Active alerts: none in last 30m. recent embeds latency spike 16:47 but resolved (see grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/embeds-latency).

Maria: okay plan: Lia will shadow until 19:30, I'll be primary 19:30–20:00 (overlap), Devon takes over 20:00. @oncall-bot please note rotation.

oncall-bot: @Maria primary -> @Devon scheduled at 2026-03-15T20:00:00Z. Overlap started at 2026-03-15T19:30:00Z. Audit ID: SWAP-7199999999.

Devon: thanks. quick checklist: 1) confirm pager routing (is primary pager group 'prim-east'?), 2) confirm access to KMS for hotkeys, 3) note any open postmortem tasks.

Lia: pager group for this window is prim-global; I verified routing with /pager status earlier. KMS okay for both Maria and Devon. no open postmortems assigned to either of you for today.

Sam: Maria — anything you want Devon to watch out for? eg. a noisy model rollout, quantized variant tests, or A/B traffic split?

Maria: keep an eye on model-svc-2 rollout (canary at 5% until tomorrow). alerts: model-svc-2 error-rate rule at 1.5% threshold (we usually cut to fallback at 2.0%). if it crosses 2.0% -> follow runbook step 3 (rollback to v2.1) and notify product.

Devon: got it. I'll add the alert to my watchlist and set a short dashboard panel. Lia — can you hands-off any session tokens or tickets I should inherit?

Lia: nothing open besides the deploy ticket for the embed fix; I'll transfer the deploy context to you via the ticket in JIRA: https://jira.redwood/browse/OPS-4521. credentials: both of you have KMS roles; no manual creds to pass.

Maria: starting overlap now. Lia, I'm toggling my status to 'available primary handing off' — will stay on call until 19:45 for any questions.

Lia: acknowledged. I'm monitoring the embed panel and the canary rollout.

oncall-bot: Audit log: user change_primary by Maria -> Devon at 2026-03-15T20:00:05Z. Pager routing updated.

Devon: I'm primary now. confirmed pager routing, dashboards up. thanks Maria & Lia. I'll take alert slack pings and the pager.

Sam: I'm secondary and on slack. I can jump if pager escalates.

Maria: all good from me. Lia — after you leave, pls put a short note in the handoff channel with any lingering items.

Lia: will do. leaving shadow at 20:15. quick follow-up items: 1) keep an eye on embed latency, 2) watch model-svc-2 error-rate, 3) notify product@redwood if rollback happens. I've posted a quick checklist at https://confluence.redwood/display/OPS/PrimSec+Swap+Checklist.

Devon: noted. thanks everyone. I'll document the swap in the rotation spreadsheet and ping oncall-ops if anything pops.

ops-bot: Post-swap reminder scheduled in 2 hours to verify handoff health.

Maria: thanks all. :thumbsup:
